issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
products.tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
products.summaryZh: 你的整个视频库：井然有序、可搜索、可理解
products.descriptionZh: Jockey 是首个能理解你整个媒体库（涵盖照片和视频）的 AI。它分析数千小时的素材，让你能在视频中查找并关联人物、时刻和上下文。可在 Claude 或 ChatGPT 中使用，也可通过 API/SDK 构建。导入 YouTube、TikTok 和 Instagram Reels 链接；将内容合成为 MP4；创建并分享带可播放片段的视频驱动工件。每次 TwelveLabs 模型升级都会让 Jockey 变得更好，无需重新集成。
products.description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

products.name: Harness by Autonomous
products.tagline: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.
products.summaryZh: 每个编码代理、每台机器，一个指挥中心。
products.descriptionZh: Harness 是面向编码代理的开源指挥中心。Claude Code 用于工作，Codex 用于家庭，Hermes 用于云端：每台机器上的每个代理，并排呈现。使用原生桌面应用、终端中的 hn，或 iOS 和 Android 应用，通过语音回复代理。端到端加密。然后借助 49 个用于 CAD、电路、机器人、游戏和音乐的 harness，超越代码。在 Mac 和 Linux 上免费。
products.description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

products.name: SignWith
products.tagline: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.
products.summaryZh: 无需订阅的电子签名。按文档付费。
products.descriptionZh: 每月免费签署3份文件，之后可购买一次性积分包，起价9美元。每个账户均包含签署顺序、邮件OTP验证、审计追踪和完成证书。可通过应用、API，或使用MCP的Claude、ChatGPT等AI助手发送。
products.description: Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

products.name: Pomerado
products.tagline: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use
products.summaryZh: 将任何网站转化为API；更快速、可靠的浏览器使用体验
products.descriptionZh: Pomerado 能在几分钟内将任何网站转化为 MCP / API。通过将以往难以访问的网站（如 Google Flights、Zillow、Instacart、遗留门户）转化为智能体的原生工具，实现全面自动化。我们的开源工具负责构建、托管、认证并维护你的集成，让你专注于构建。
products.description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

products.name: Hintly for Google Meet™
products.tagline: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet
products.summaryZh: 在Google Meet中，每当你错过一个术语，都会得到实时提示。
products.descriptionZh: Hintly 会在 Google Meet 通话中有人提到术语、名称和事物后，随即进行解释。
products.description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

products.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
products.tagline: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
products.summaryZh: 你可以指导的AI配音，而不只是生成
products.descriptionZh: Drama 3 是 Fish Audio 最新的 AI 语音模型，专为可导演的表演而打造。借助自然语言控制，将脚本转化为富有表现力的语音，可调控情绪、节奏、耳语、笑声和停顿——甚至能在单句内实现。可创作多角色场景、有声书、游戏对话和旁白，支持 83 种语言。可在网页端、移动端和 API 上使用，并在 Fish Audio 社区许可下提供开放权重以供自托管。
products.description: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

products.name: Dottr
products.tagline: Agent that drafts contracts, flags risks + gets them signed
products.summaryZh: 起草合同、标记风险并完成签署的代理
products.descriptionZh: Dottr 是存在于你邮箱中的合同 AI 队友。转发邮件线程或笔记，它便会依据你的模板起草协议，用通俗英文审查风险，发送签署，并持续跟进每位签署人直至完成。签署人无需登录。它还会记住条款和日期，方便你日后查询已同意的内容。从起草到签署一气呵成，让确认不再搁置变冷。
products.description: Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.

products.name: Parallax
products.tagline: Every coding agent you run, in one place.
products.summaryZh: 你运行的每个编码代理，都集中在一处。
products.descriptionZh: Parallax 为你运行编码智能体。Claude Code、Codex 等 40 多款工具集成于一个应用，240 多款模型基于你自己的订阅运行。Captain 处理繁琐工作，快速合并一键提交你的 PR；当某个订阅用尽时，自动回退让你的工作无缝切换到下一个。
products.description: Parallax runs your coding agents for you. Claude Code, Codex and 40+ more in one app, with 240+ models on your own subscriptions. Captain handles the busywork, fast merge ships your PRs in one click, and when a subscription runs out, auto fallback enables your work to move to the next.

products.name: Lovable Growth Tools
products.tagline: From building your app to growing it, in one chat
products.summaryZh: 从构建应用到推动增长，尽在一次对话中
products.descriptionZh: Lovable 现在可以帮助你发展业务。设定一个目标，比如“我的前 100 个注册用户”，然后基于你的应用生成一份发布方案。在 Google 搜索、YouTube、地图、Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放广告。借助 Semrush 数据，在 Google 和 AI 搜索中被发现。基于你的构建创建图像、视频和文案。不同于代理机构或一堆工具，它就在你的应用和流量旁边，并且在任何支出之前都由你批准。
products.description: Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.

products.name: Taim
products.tagline: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI.
products.summaryZh: 捕捉它。Taim 归档、安排，并与你的 AI 同步。
products.descriptionZh: Taim 是你的想法捕捉助手。说出心中所想，一切自会各归其位：想法自动归入正确的线索，待办事项则转化为任务、提醒和日历事件。通过 MCP 连接后，你使用的每个智能体都能即时获取你的上下文。
products.description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.

products.name: BOSS Console
products.tagline: A tiny OS for your always-on agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的常驻代理打造的微型操作系统
products.descriptionZh: BOSS Console 是一个为常驻代理设计的微型操作系统。你可以用真实工具创建自己的代理，在 fluck.ai 上聊天，并通过 cli.risaboss.com 访问实时会话。
products.description: BOSS Console is a tiny OS for your always-on agents. Create your own agent with real tools, chat at fluck.ai, and access live sessions at cli.risaboss.com.

products.name: Muse Spark Open
products.tagline: The most capable US open weights model to date
products.summaryZh: 迄今为止最强大的美国开放权重模型
products.descriptionZh: Meta 面向编程与智能体工作打造的开源权重模型。总参数 816B，激活参数 42B，上下文窗口 1M token，原生支持多模态输入。可在 Hugging Face 下载权重，或在两台搭载 MLX 的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 上运行。
products.description: Meta's open weights model built for coding and agentic work. 816B total parameters with 42B active, a 1M token context window and native multimodal input. Download the weights on Hugging Face or run it on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

products.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
products.tagline: NVIDIA’s open multimodal model for specialized agents
products.summaryZh: NVIDIA面向专用智能体的开放多模态模型
products.descriptionZh: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 是 NVIDIA 面向专用智能体推出的开放、可定制多模态模型。它是一个 120B 混合专家模型，拥有 12B 激活参数，可在单一模型中处理文本、图像、文档和视频输入，并支持推理与工具使用。NVIDIA 称，在单块 GPU 上，其智能体吞吐量最高可达同等规模开放模型的 5 倍。检查点、训练配方和数据集已在 Hugging Face 上发布，并提供 NIM 容器。
products.description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA’s open, customizable multimodal model for specialized agents. It is a 120B mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters that handles text, image, document, and video input, plus reasoning and tool use, in one model. NVIDIA claims up to 5x higher agentic throughput on a single GPU than open models its size. Checkpoints, training recipes, and datasets are on Hugging Face, with a NIM container.

products.name: GBrain Tools
products.tagline: A password manager for AI
products.summaryZh: 用于AI的密码管理器
products.descriptionZh: GBrain Tools 是一款面向 AI 的密码管理器。只需一次连接 Gmail、GitHub、Stripe、Notion 等众多服务，即可在 ChatGPT、Claude、Claude Code、Cursor 或终端中使用它们。没有任何 AI 持有密码，所有操作都记录在同一份日志中。每月 19 美元。
products.description: GBrain Tools is a password manager for AI. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe, Notion and many more once, then use them from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or your terminal. No AI holds a password, and every action lands on one log. $19 a month.

products.name: NANI???
products.tagline: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know.
products.summaryZh: 你的翻译和你的老板甚至都不知道。
products.descriptionZh: 什么？你是否曾在通话中全程听不懂，然后才意识到有人刚问了你一个问题？“什么？”会在你的 Mac 上通过声音识别谁在说话，并在任何通话中悬浮显示实时翻译字幕。没有机器人加入，所以没人会发现。当老板问你事情时，它会发出提示音并建议你可以回复的内容，甚至可以用你不会说的语言。通话前添加背景信息和词汇表，通话后获取摘要和行动项。下次，你就不用说“什么？？？”了。
products.description: NANI??? Ever sat through a call understanding nothing, then realised someone just asked you a question? Nani? learns who’s speaking by voice, right on your Mac, and floats live translated subtitles over any call. No bot joins, so nobody sees a thing. When your boss asks you something, it chimes and suggests replies you can say back, even in a language you don’t speak. Add context and a glossary before the call, and get a summary with action items after. Next time, you won’t have to say NANI???

products.name: Tidy Design
products.tagline: Open Source Paper / Figma Alternative
products.summaryZh: 开源 Paper / Figma 替代品
products.descriptionZh: Tidy 是面向设计师、工程师和 AI 代理的 Figma 与 Paper 开源替代品。你可以直接从编码环境（Claude Code、Codex、Opencode 等）设计界面、浏览源代码，并按自己的工作方式调整工具。
products.description: Tidy is an open source alternative to Figma and Paper for designers, engineers, and AI agents. Design interfaces directly from your coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, etc), explore the source code, and adapt the tool to fit how you work.

products.name: Tesla Roadster
products.tagline: The hypercar that flies
products.summaryZh: 飞驰的超级跑车
products.descriptionZh: Roadster 的性能表现超越任何量产车。它超越 Plaid，开启驾驶的全新维度。它挑战设计、工程与物理的极限，成就一款精心打造的非凡座驾。
products.description: Roadster can perform at levels unlike any other production car. It goes beyond Plaid to unlock an entirely new dimension of driving. It challenges the limits of design, engineering and physics to deliver an expertly crafted extra-terrestrial vehicle.

products.name: Memory Chess
products.tagline: Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory
products.summaryZh: 研究一个国际象棋局面，然后凭记忆重建它
products.descriptionZh: 记忆棋向你展示一个棋局几秒钟，然后清空棋盘，由你将棋子放回原位。2.0版本是我们迄今最大的一次更新：每日棋盘人人可玩一次，双向变动的技能评分，记忆跨度与进度仪表盘，可分享的对局回放，以及支持24种语言的全新设计。免费，无需账户。欢迎来Telegram与其他玩家打招呼、交换分数：t.me/TheMemoryChess
products.description: Memory Chess shows you a chess position for a few seconds, clears the board, and you put the pieces back. Version 2.0 is our biggest update yet: a daily board everyone plays once, a skill rating that moves both ways, a dashboard of your memory span and progress, shareable round replays, and a redesign in 24 languages. Free, no account. Come say hi and swap scores with other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

products.name: Firefox Enterprise
products.tagline: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data
products.summaryZh: 为希望掌控自身数据的企业打造的Firefox
products.descriptionZh: Firefox Enterprise 将 Mozilla 的独立浏览器技术带给希望加强对 IT 基础设施和数据控制的企业。它基于 Gecko 引擎构建，提供自托管管理控制台，用于集中管理浏览器策略、访问权限、数据流动和 AI 使用。它可与现有的身份、安全和设备管理系统协同工作，帮助企业减少对主导浏览器生态系统的依赖。
products.description: Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

products.name: Chathonk
products.tagline: Instant chat, web games, and audio calls with friends
products.summaryZh: 即时聊天、网页游戏和与朋友的音频通话
products.descriptionZh: 一个有趣且引人入胜的聊天平台，让你与朋友保持联系，通过电子邮件或用户名搜索用户，并用表情符号和GIF为对话增添趣味。
products.description: A fun and engaging chat platform that lets you connect with friends, search for users by email or username, and spice up your conversations with emojis and GIFs.
